title: Bound on remainder rounds
statement: For natural numbers $a,M,V$ with $a\le V$, the number of base-size rounds needed to reduce $a$ by division by $M$, defined as the binary size of $\lfloor a/M\rfloor$, is at most $\lfloor\log_2(V+1)\rfloor+1$.
